question: What obligation requires concealment of a certain teaching when placed among the lowest of men in the mortal world?
premises: A teaching must be concealed with effort.
The mortal world contains those of lowest capacity.
Concealment is directed to those among the lowest of men.
inference: The teaching is to be concealed with effort in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
plain_english: This teaching is to be concealed with effort in the mortal world, among the lowest of men.
